title: DocumentSegment
description: Represents an individual document or logical page segment within an uploaded tender or bidder submission package.

document_id.description: Unique identifier for the document or segment (e.g., DOC-BID001-TECH-01).

parent_file.description: Name or relative path of the parent container file (e.g., BID-00001.pdf or tender_spec.pdf).

document_type.description: Functional classification of the document segment.

page_start.description: Starting 1-indexed page number within the parent container file.

page_end.description: Ending 1-indexed page number within the parent container file (must be >= page_start).

source.description: Origin of the document within the procurement lifecycle.

extraction_status.description: Current processing/extraction status of the document.

classification_confidence.description: Confidence level in the document type classification.

text_preview.description: First few hundred characters or summary extracted from the segment.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata (e.g. file_size, mime_type, sha256_hash, language).
